page.overview:
Who is Dudley Cabrera?

Soyona Santos's Dinosaur Trafficking Ring}}

Dudley Cabrera was a Hispanic-American regional district manager who was employed as the regional director for the Department of Prehistoric Wildlife in the American Southwest, where he secretly worked with smugglers in administrating the illegal buying and selling of dinosaurs, a harbor facility in the South Center of Louisiana on the Gulf Coast near the Atchafalaya river basin, was the major drop point for his illegal activities. He was the secondary antagonist in season 1 of Jurassic World: Chaos Theory.

He was working with the Atrociraptor Handler and for her employer Soyona Santos in the smuggling ring and eventually helped them take care of the Nublar Six.

Dudley Cabrera was characterized by pride, selfishness and egoism, claiming that he doesn't want to hurt people on purpose, however he shows no guilt in doing so, he was also extremely greedy, even implying that if he has to make a choice between his operation and the Nublar Six lives, he would choose the operation, other enforce of his egoism, is the fact that he tried to obligate the Nublar Six to do his biding despite the group clearly rejecting the offer, however, despite his arrogance, Cabrera was not completely immoral, he had also a more moral side, as it is showed that he doesn't want to kill the Nublar Six, and sent the Allosaurus just to scare Brooklynn, furthermore he showed to care about the way his employers were mistreating the dinosaurs.
